intent.description: Search Google Flights for one-way itineraries with passenger and recorded filter controls.
intent.userSaid: searched for flights and played with stops, bags, price, time, and duration filters

parameters.name: trip_type
parameters.description: Only one_way is supported by this emitted search tool.

parameters.name: cabin_class
parameters.description: Only economy is supported by the recording.

parameters.name: max_stops
parameters.description: Maximum stops per leg; 0 means unrestricted.

parameters.name: alliances
parameters.description: Comma-separated alliance codes: ONEWORLD, SKYTEAM, or STAR_ALLIANCE.

parameters.name: carry_on_bags
parameters.description: Only 0 is supported by the recording.

parameters.name: outbound_time_range
parameters.description: departure_start,departure_end,arrival_start,arrival_end; each hour must be an integer from 0 through 23.

parameters.name: sort_order
parameters.description: best, price, departure_time, arrival_time, or duration.

limitations.reason: The recorded shopping contract requires the static USD page metadata header and provides no grounded request position for varying currency independently.
The recordings and live verification ground economy only.
The recorded field did not produce a discriminating live result, so only the unfiltered value 0 is supported.
The recording did not exercise infant passenger changes, and live differentials produced incomplete carrier results without passenger-adjusted fares.
Google's recorded server price slot can omit cheaper baseline itineraries at restrictive caps, so max_price is enforced as a deterministic postcondition over the returned result set.
The emitted producer currently proves complete one-way selections only. Use get_flight_calendar_prices for round-trip price discovery; later-leg staged selection remains user-assisted.
